hf.tokenizer.title: Local HF fast tokenizer
hf.tokenizer.description: Build a real offline WordLevel PreTrainedTokenizerFast from an editable vocabulary.

hf.tokenize.title: Tokenize text
hf.tokenize.description: Tokenize and pad text; causal labels mask padding with -100.

hf.optimizer.title: Optimizer
hf.optimizer.description: Optimizer recipe. Connect to Train alongside a model; AdamW updates the model's complete parameter set.

hf.train.title: Train multi-parameter model
hf.train.description: Actual autograd/optimizer updates, finite loss checks, gradient clipping, measured parameter hashes and loss history.

hf.evaluate.title: Evaluate model
hf.evaluate.description: Evaluate a finite loss and optional classification accuracy without changing weights.

hf.generate.title: HF generate
hf.generate.description: Real bounded HF autoregressive generation with attention masks and deterministic default sampling.

hf.pipeline.title: HF pipeline
hf.pipeline.description: Actual Transformers pipeline with a job-local model/tokenizer, offline inference and bounded inputs.

hf.inspect.title: Inspect model
hf.inspect.description: Real parameter names, shapes, trainable counts, architecture, finite checks and weight hash.

hf.checkpoint.title: Export safe model
hf.checkpoint.description: Immutable ZIP with safetensors weights and a declarative architecture recipe. No pickle or executable model code.

hf.load.title: Load safe model
hf.load.description: Load only a registered graph artifact, verify safe ZIP/recipe/safetensors and rebuild within model budgets.

hf.tensor_input.title: Token / mask input
hf.tensor_input.description: A symbolic model input. Its connected operations replay on every forward pass, training update and generated token.

hf.op_embedding.title: Token embedding
hf.op_embedding.description: Editable trainable vocabulary table; converts token IDs into hidden vectors.

hf.op_linear.title: Projection / LM head
hf.op_linear.description: A separately registered trainable Linear projection. Use for Q, K, V, attention output, gate, up, down or vocabulary head.

hf.op_rmsnorm.title: RMSNorm operation
hf.op_rmsnorm.description: Trainable RMS normalization in the forward graph, with float32 variance accumulation and editable epsilon.

hf.op_positions.title: Position IDs from mask
hf.op_positions.description: Convert a binary padding mask to zero-based, padding-aware position IDs for rotary embeddings.

hf.op_rope.title: Rotary position / RoPE
hf.op_rope.description: Apply real split-half rotary position embeddings to a Q or K projection. Connect editable position IDs or use the batch mask's positions.

hf.op_attention.title: Grouped-query causal attention
hf.op_attention.description: Q/K/V tensor inputs, grouped KV heads, scaled scores, padding/causal mask, softmax and weighted values. Every connection participates in autograd.

hf.op_silu.title: SiLU activation
hf.op_silu.description: The parameter-free activation in the expanded SwiGLU gate branch.

hf.op_multiply.title: Gated product
hf.op_multiply.description: Elementwise multiply two equally shaped tensors, for the SiLU gate × up branch.

hf.op_add.title: Residual addition
hf.op_add.description: Add two equally shaped tensor branches without hiding the skip connection.

hf.graph_model.title: Compile visual causal model
hf.graph_model.description: Compile the connected tensor DAG into a trainable causal language model. Shared visual nodes register weights once; the saved recipe replays for training, generation and checkpoint reload.
